metadata.description: Official AI Maestro plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: ai-maestro-plugin
plugins.description: AI agent orchestration — agent management, memory search (transcripts), markdown memory protocol (memory-recall/memory-write skills, memory-protocol rule, memgrep), code graph, AMP messaging, AID identity, docs search, planning, team governance, team kanban, MCP discovery, hook debugging, network security. Requires AI Maestro server.

plugins.name: ai-maestro-assistant-manager-agent
plugins.description: MANAGER title — user interlocutor, directs other agents

plugins.name: ai-maestro-assistant-role-agent
plugins.description: ASSISTANT title — one per human user; plans like a MANAGER, programs like an AUTONOMOUS agent

plugins.name: ai-maestro-chief-of-staff
plugins.description: CHIEF-OF-STAFF title — per-team agent management, staff planning

plugins.name: ai-maestro-architect-agent
plugins.description: ARCHITECT title — design documents, requirements, architecture

plugins.name: ai-maestro-orchestrator-agent
plugins.description: ORCHESTRATOR title — task distribution, kanban, coordination

plugins.name: ai-maestro-integrator-agent
plugins.description: INTEGRATOR title — quality gates, PR review, merging, releases

plugins.name: ai-maestro-programmer-agent
plugins.description: PROGRAMMER title — general-purpose implementer, writes code

plugins.name: ai-maestro-maintainer-agent
plugins.description: MAINTAINER title — polls GitHub issues, triages bugs, fixes valid issues via publish pipeline

plugins.name: ai-maestro-autonomous-agent
plugins.description: AUTONOMOUS title — mandatory role-plugin for no-team agents; enforces workspace isolation, forbids cross-agent mutation, respects AMP comm graph

plugins.name: ai-maestro-janitor
plugins.description: Session-scoped janitor — reconciles PRs/worktrees/TRDD drift/task-PR mismatches, auto-resumes on rate-limit, keeps prompt cache warm via a single durable CronCreate heartbeat. No external daemon.

plugins.name: ai-maestro-visual-communicator-plugin
plugins.description: Generate interactive HTML pages — diagrams, diff reviews, plan reviews, slide decks, data tables, and v2 modal-comment agent reports. Every page sends the user's selection (or per-element comment thread) back to the agent.

plugins.name: web-scenario-tester
plugins.description: Browser-driven UI scenario-testing harness: author, run, and batch end-to-end scenario tests against a running web app via dev-browser, with fix-as-you-go, screenshots, structured reports, and 11th-hour improvement proposals. AI-Maestro MEMBER role-plugin.

plugins.name: ai-maestro-webdesign
plugins.description: Consolidated web-design MEMBER role-plugin: design judgment (Claude Design principles), ASCII sketch/parse, diagrams, infographics, style extraction, design.md authoring/audit, and browser-verified preview. amw-design-principles orchestrates every sub-skill; amw-dev-browser is the single browser-automation primitive.

plugins.name: dev-browser
plugins.description: Browser automation skill with persistent page state for developers and AI agents. Emasoft-audited fork of SawyerHood/dev-browser, source-pinned at the upstream v1.0.0 release commit (supply-chain pin — ai-maestro-plugin#19, TRDD-LEMJMCAQ). Resolver tag dev-browser--v1.0.0 targets the same commit.
